title: Always-On AI Automation Daemon -- AppBot Eye Internals
desc: Eye = always-on overlay + Slack daemon + MCP broker in one process. FSW hybrid dirty-check: event flags (~0ms) + 1s FileInfo safety net. MCP workers isolated via DETACHED_PROCESS (ConPTY LPC deadlock prevention). Hot-swap: detects core.new.exe stamp -> defers if admin pipe busy -> skips same failed stamp -> spawns new Eye. Admin proxy: named pipe wkappbot_elevated, amber border when admin-capable.
steps: Eye = always-on overlay + Slack daemon + MCP broker (one process). FSW dirty-check: event ~0ms + 1s FileInfo safety net. Never kill Eye directly -- kills active sessions.
MCP workers run in DETACHED_PROCESS (ConPTY LPC deadlock prevention). Hot-swap: watches core.new.exe stamp, defers if admin pipe busy, skips same failed stamp, spawns new Eye.
Admin-capable mode: amber border, proxies via wkappbot_elevated named pipe. NEVER mix with normal Eye tick channel wkappbot_eye_ipc.

REFLEX: plain wkbuild.cmd does NOT hot-swap a running Eye (no .new.exe marker by design) -- use wktest-promote.sh to observe a C# change live via the bare wkappbot command, or wkappbot-core <args> directly to bypass Eye for fast dev iteration.
